ns2:course.label: Acting Studio III: Movement
ns2:course.description: Training in stage combat, sword, and rapier. Enrollment limited to Theatre majors. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. 2 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: THEA 375, THEA 376, THEA 377 and THEA 378, and concurrent registration in THEA 471, THEA 472 and THEA 474.
